adds.title: Transgender rights in Argentina (Wikipedia) — Prisons section: 2025 women's-prison housing restriction
adds.summary: Wikipedia article 'Transgender rights in Argentina' (rev. 23 Aug 2026), Prisons section: in February 2025, President Javier Milei's government implemented a ban on being housed in a women's prison for trans women convicted of sexual crimes, human trafficking, or any violent crime against a woman. The dated rule is a restriction on women's-prison housing for trans women in specific conviction categories; the article records no other trans-specific housing rule or separate trans unit, implying the operative baseline (for trans women not in those conviction categories) is women's-prison housing. National-level policy; the article contains no Buenos Aires province-specific placement rule.

records.note: No Buenos Aires-province-specific placement rule for trans prisoners was found within this lane's budget (one enwiki full-text search 'transgender prisoners Argentina' + two candidate fetches). The only dated, verifiable housing fact for Argentina is national: Wikipedia's 'Transgender rights in Argentina' (Prisons section) records that in February 2025 the Milei government banned housing in a women's prison for trans women convicted of sexual crimes, human trafficking, or any violent crime against a woman — a restriction implying that women's-prison housing was otherwise the operative baseline and that no gender-identity-based placement rule or trans-specific unit is documented. The shared global article 'LGBTQ people in prison' covers Argentina only on conjugal visits, not housing.

No documentation on where trans prisoners are housed in Poland was found within this lane's budget (one enwiki full-text search 'transgender prisoners Poland' + two candidate fetches). The Wikipedia full-text search returned no jurisdiction-specific prison page; the fetched global article 'LGBTQ people in prison' mentions Poland only in a reference footnote citing a HEUNI 2018 paper on prison health care (MacDonald, 'Prison Health Care in the Czech Republic, Hungary and Poland') — a health-care study, not housing placement; 'Transgender rights in Poland' redirects to 'LGBTQ rights in Poland', which contains no prison-housing, inmate-placement, or detention-policy content. No Podkarpackie-specific data either. adds=[] is honest: no fabrication attempted.
